content:
In order to enable OpenSearch Ingestion to send logs to CloudWatch Logs, you must be signed in
as a user that has certain IAM permissions.
You need the following CloudWatch Logs permissions in order to create and update log delivery
resources:
JSON
{
"Version":"2012-10-17",
"Statement": [
{
"Effect": "Allow",
"Resource": "*",
"Action": [
"logs:CreateLogDelivery",
"logs:PutResourcePolicy",
"logs:UpdateLogDelivery",
"logs:DeleteLogDelivery",
"logs:DescribeResourcePolicies",
"logs:GetLogDelivery",
"logs:ListLogDeliveries"
]
}
]
}
